results.title: Comeback Dad
results.overview: An out-of-shape comedian and his 17-year-old son set off on a last-minute road trip. Unable to see eye to eye, these two polar opposites of masculinity clash inside a cramped car. Amidst conflicts and emotions, they discover they need to view the world from each other's perspective to finally understand one another.

results.title: Hand of Justice
results.overview: Blagoje Jovović, a war hero, after World War II moves to Buenos Aires. There he tries to lead a normal life, but an encounter with a man with ustasha tattoo brings up old wounds and desire for vengeance.

results.title: Ria
results.overview: Facing the threat of demolition from a ruthless developer, young folk-punk Ria joins her foster mother and their punk community to defend their home, the last surviving building standing amid the ruins of their neighborhood.

results.title: One of Them
results.overview: Audrey is a young woman from Lens who dreams of escaping her fate when she meets the Authentiks, a group of Ultras football fans. With them she discovers the fervour of a new world and gradually changes her outlook on herself and the world in ways she never imagined.

results.title: Dead End
results.overview: Herman is a computer programmer and the father of a one-year-old daughter. When Lok appears, claiming to be his half-brother and pressing him about their father's death, Herman's everyday life begins to unravel. Then one day, Lok, who has been hovering around Herman and relentlessly triggering his trauma, suddenly disappears.

results.title: Too Soon
results.overview: A Second Shot at love comes sooner than expected for a young widow and widower who meet the day of their spouses' funerals.

results.title: Analog Eyes
results.overview: A loner dork gets fed up with the monotony of his existence under the shadow of his narcissistic friend. Forcing the the pair to reevaluate their place in life.

results.title: A Cha-Cha for the Fugitive
results.overview: A bisexual artist is waiting to move to New York City to be with his male lover while living with his girlfriend in a sumptuous loft in Taipei. In order to save enough money to implement the trip to New York, he joins the dancing group that formed part of the fat stripteaser's show. Later on, he takes his girlfriend to Yenshui for the firecracker festival and happens to witness a weird murder with video recorder in hand. He then becomes the target of the mysterious killer...

results.title: Desperate for Fame
results.overview: Everything that glitters isn't gold and sometimes it definitely comes at a price!

results.title: First Light - Danny Teare
results.overview: After experiencing a stroke, Danny Teare found it increasingly difficult to surf. That did not keep him down though and he found his love of the ocean again through dawn bodysurfs. This is what surfing means to him.

results.title: Brad Upton: Code Blue
results.overview: Brad Upton has spent decades finding the funny in getting older. In CODE BLUE, he may have more material than ever.  From pill caddies and bad drivers to marriage, kids, generational differences and the indignities that come with aging, Brad brings his sharp, boomer perspective to an hour of comedy about a life well lived—and a body that occasionally has other plans.  Behind the laughs is a deeply personal story that gave Brad a new appreciation for taking life as it comes, enjoying the ride and finding humor even when things don’t go according to plan.  Funny, personal and unexpectedly heartfelt, CODE BLUE is Brad Upton at his best: laughing at life, aging on his own terms and proving there’s always something worth finding funny along the way.

results.title: Vinyl Thief
results.overview: After a chance encounter with a hipster music producer, a young punk rock musician becomes determined to track down an obscure vinyl record that could change the course of his fledgling career. His search sends him on an unexpected journey through Los Angeles, but there’s one thing in his way: his estranged brother.

results.title: Start the Show
results.overview: A horror musical short centering on a 1930s starlet as she fights for agency and survival in a cyclical Betty Boop inspired hell.

results.title: Moko: Bisikan Logam Tua
results.overview: Behind the beauty of the sea and the calm hills of Alor Island, lies the mystery of an old bronze drum called Moko, an inanimate object with magical powers that is believed to be able to come to life, change form, and even demand sacrifices. But for the Abui people, Moko is more than just a sacred myth; it's a wedding dowry and an "eternal debt" that can delay burial and force parents to sweat until their last drop of blood. Through Yoel's emotional narrative and the silent cries of the guardians of tradition, this documentary reveals a profound question: where is the line between inherited dignity and the shackles that cost humanity tears?

results.title: Stênio
results.overview: In his studio in Juazeiro do Norte, woodcut artist and "Master of Popular Culture" of Ceará, Stenio Diniz, rediscovers a piece of wood - scarred by termites after years of neglect. Through his memories, the lessons he has learned, and his artistic practice, his actions reveal a co-authorship with nature - and the persistence of someone who keeps popular culture alive.

results.title: Possible Futures: Designing Tomorrow in the Netherlands
results.original_title: Possible Futures: Designing Tomorrow in the Netherlands
results.overview: Following five teams of designers investigating the future of water, energy, housing, mobility, agriculture, and care, the film explores how design research can help imagine and debate the future of the Netherlands.

results.title: One Team in Tallinn: 30 Years On
results.original_title: One Team in Tallinn: 30 Years On
results.overview: In October 1996, it was full steam ahead for the Tartan Army on the way to the World Cup in France. However, when Scotland lined up to face Estonia in Tallinn, there was just one thing missing - the opposition.

results.title: Splatter
results.overview: As a violent, supernatural force begins to hollow her out from the inside, a young woman must survive appointments with a gynaecologist who insists her gruesome physical symptoms are just part of being a woman.

results.title: Coaching for Ordinary People
results.overview: Coaching is a phenomenon of our time – the promised fast track to finding yourself. The film follows Pille, Armin and Lii as they begin working with a personal coach, to see where it takes them. Pille wants to earn €20,000 a month. Lii wants to get better at setting personal boundaries and stop dealing with toxic men. Armin’s goal is to become a better version of himself and become a life coach himself. Will they reach their goals, or will life have other plans? Warm, funny and sharp, the film takes an intimate look at the protagonists’ search for themselves and makes us wonder why we are so intent on becoming better, more successful and happier. Is it even possible to become who we want to be?

results.title: Playback
results.overview: When Jess is given the footage of her missing sister’s last moments, she triggers unfortunate events to unfold.
